preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= H <= 1000 and 1 <= W <= 1000 and 1 <= N <= 200 for H, W, N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, H, W, and N are between 1 and 1000, 1 and 1000, and 1 and 200, respectively.

preconditions.expression: all(all(-1000 <= h[i][j] <= 1000 for j in range(W)) for H, W, N, h, particles in test_cases for i in range(H))
preconditions.description: Each cell value h[i][j] in the grid is between -1000 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= y[i] <= H and 1 <= x[i] <= W and 1 <= abs(p[i]) <= 100 for i in range(N)) for H, W, N, h, particles in test_cases for y, x, p in [list(zip(*particles))])
preconditions.description: Each particle's position (y[i], x[i]) is within the grid bounds, and each particle's absolute value |p[i]| is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(len(set((y[i], x[i]) for i in range(N))) == N for H, W, N, h, particles in test_cases for y, x, p in [list(zip(*particles))])
preconditions.description: No two particles are located in the same cell.

postconditions.description: Each test case's output consists of exactly two lines.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[0], int) for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case's output is an integer representing the maximum value of V.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output[1]) == N for output, N in zip(outputs, [N for H, W, N, h, particles in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: The second line of each test case's output contains exactly N integers.

postconditions.expression: all(all(sign in [1, -1] for sign in output[1]) for output in outputs)
postconditions.description: Each integer in the second line of each test case's output is either 1 or -1.

postconditions.expression: all(output[0] == max_value for output, max_value in zip(outputs, [calculate_max_value(H, W, N, h, particles) for H, W, N, h, particles in test_cases]))
postconditions.description: The first line of each test case's output is the maximum value of V, calculated based on the given grid and particle positions.
